def eye_and_len():
    a=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    # green eye: r pixel on row 10 that is NOT part of cross (cross cols 51-53)
    row=a[10]; ns=[j for j in range(64) if row[j]=='N']
    gmin,gmax=min(ns),max(ns)
    # green eye = rightmost r on row10 beyond cross
    rs=[j for j in range(64) if row[j]=='r']
    geye=max(rs) if rs else None
    # yellow: col 10
    col=[a[i][10] for i in range(64)]
    ys=[i for i in range(64) if col[i]=='Y']
    ymin,ymax=min(ys),max(ys)
    rsc=[i for i in range(64) if col[i]=='r']
    yeye=max(rsc) if rsc else None
    return dict(g=(gmin,gmax,gmax-gmin+1), geye=geye, y=(ymin,ymax,ymax-ymin+1), yeye=yeye)
